description: This file defines a TokenCache class used internally to manage OAuth tokens (access and refresh tokens), along with related error handling via MongoOIDCError. It provides methods to store, retrieve, and remove tokens and IDP info for MongoDB OIDC authentication.

classes.name: TokenCache
classes.description: A class that manages OAuth tokens for MongoDB OIDC authentication, including storing, retrieving, and removing access and refresh tokens, as well as associated IDP information.

methods.name: getAccessToken
methods.description: Returns the current access token, throws error if none exists.

methods.name: getRefreshToken
methods.description: Returns the current refresh token, throws error if none exists.

methods.name: getIdpInfo
methods.description: Returns the IDP information, throws error if none exists.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores access token, refresh token, expiration info, and optionally IDP info based on the response.
